study.question: Does the observed raw-action/mask-signature equality survive a common nonzero categorical start, and does event-specific mask coding help beyond a constant action token under that same start?
study.hypothesis: Observation: the unchanged full-action model has click AUC0.6689610675617089; g2-r0081-full_action_zero_init, g2-r0081-mask_signature_zero_init and g2-r0081-mask_signature_zero_affine all report identical AUC0.6684436187920456, per-task metrics and history-slice metrics. Earlier random-row mask-only variants were0.66770143818384 and0.6682743327144265; blind_constant was0.6433040120460289. These trajectories contradict attributing every full/blind gap to information absent from task masks. Mechanism hypothesis: much of the apparent action advantage is efficient categorical access to feedback already represented in the supplied masks, while arbitrary embedding row initialization contributes to the remaining original-control gap. Zero initialization may be a special case. A common nonzero vector removes initial row-label differences without setting action inputs to zero and permits independent rows to specialize. Raw and complete mask-signature inputs should again match; a constant code may lose because it removes this event-specific representation. This is an attribution hypothesis, not a new architecture or novelty claim.

nearest_work.difference: Archived exact-version primary paper lines250-277 describe target-dependent unnormalized weighted history pooling. The local baseline adapts this to item/action fields and four tasks. This study preserves the already stronger model and changes only action coding/initialization; it does not introduce local activation or claim an exact original DIN reproduction.

Pinned primary upstream source lines383-408 constructs task membership from action-name tokens, and530-551 supplies the same action prefix, action-derived task masks and zero target action. This establishes that masks carry feedback, but not that every observed action ID has a unique mask signature. The proposed treatment explicitly discards raw action values while retaining those masks.

Pinned source lines55-117 creates the categorical nn.Embedding table and optional sharing/encoders; lines132-142 initialize it. New constructor checks exclude sharing/encoders and preserve table shape; the only added initialization copies an already drawn nonspecial row into all nonpadding rows.

Pinned benchmark forward123-170 initializes task hubs using task-specific masks, showing another explicit mask-access route. No hub aggregation/broadcast operator is adopted. Original INFNet paper detail is not audited here and no local transfer result is claimed.

Pinned benchmark forward113-145 pools history before unified token interactions. No heterogeneous transformer/tokenizer is added; this study keeps the incumbent architecture so action coding is the contrast. Original-paper mechanism equivalence remains unverified.

inherited_components: Entire g3-r0058-fixed_angle_negative source architecture and CONFIG, also byte-identical to g2-r0081-full_action_control. Initial DIN is retained as an empirical reference, not rerun or imposed as a new design.
Action-aware local activation, uniform/feedback history compression, target-match and ordinal/quadratic summaries, per-task residual banks and context-history product corrections.
Original private/shared gradient gates, joint true-label auxiliary objectives and fixed-angle negative shared-context surrogate VJP. This VJP is not the ordinary derivative of the scalar joint BCE.
Mask-signature coding principle and nonspecial-row checks from history_g2_r0081_mask_signature_zero_init.py; common-start attribution principle inherited from its zero-initialization pair.
study.proposed_difference: Four standalone variants: unchanged full-action utility control; raw actions with every nonpadding action-table row copied once from the first nonspecial inherited random row; mask-only complete four-bit signatures under that same start; and one constant nonspecial token under that start. Zero row0 and any declared embedding padding row. No added random draws, modules, parameters, buffers or training loss changes. The latter three all compute the same mask signature/codebook helper before selecting their action treatment. The action-table anchor is native scale, not a tuned magnitude. Copies initialize independent rows rather than tying or freezing them. No other data or source is introduced.
predictions: Predeclared primary comparison is full-population validation click AUC. Practical descriptive equivalence margin is abs(raw_common_nonzero - mask_common_nonzero)<=0.0002, chosen before new outcomes; it is not a statistical equivalence test or a significance threshold. Also compare logloss and all task/history-slice outputs; do not select on auxiliary mean AUC.

If code partitions are one-to-one on occupied events, common-start raw and mask-only forward values, gradients and learned predictions should agree after relabeling up to arithmetic/scatter effects; identical aggregate metrics alone are weaker evidence.

With all nonpadding rows initially equal, all three treatment arms should have identical initial predictions for the same authorized batch, including nonempty histories. At least one nonzero anchor component is a host preflight requirement; otherwise this is an accidental zero-start rerun.

The constant arm may lose>0.0002 AUC to both categorical arms after training even though initial predictions agree. Such a loss supports explicit event-specific representation of mask-available feedback; it does not demonstrate new raw-action information.

Expected allocated parameter count is32192421 (31793216 embedding,399205 dense) from unchanged module definitions and existing receipts; host must measure. Measure actual wall/allocated-GPU seconds, examples, peak memory, inference throughput and p50/p95 latency; do not infer efficiency from parameter equality.
falsifiers: Raw common-nonzero exceeds mask-only by>0.0002 click AUC after valid input/initialization checks: proposed common-start robustness fails locally. A reverse difference is also evidence against numerical/functional equivalence, not evidence of raw utility.
Constant common-nonzero matches or improves on both categorical arms within the descriptive margin: event-specific categorical specialization is not established as useful under this start.
Mask-only retains a material gap to the unchanged0.6689610675617089 control: do not claim recovery of strongest-visible-model utility, even if the matched raw/mask arms agree.

Initial predictions or non-action state differ across the three treatments, raw/signature partitions collide non-bijectively, target action is nonzero, padding changes, or input masks/item fields are mutated: suspend pure action-information interpretation and record the failed gate and its costs.
A single frozen-seed contrast cannot establish general or repeated mechanism support; unchanged same-seed utility replay is not replication across seeds.
alternative_explanations: Zero-start equality may rely on symmetry or a very small initial action contribution. The native-scale common nonzero start is the proposed discriminating follow-up, not a guarantee of broader initialization robustness.

Task masks deterministically depend on action names in the loader; raw codes may therefore be redundant, but the supplied source lacks the actual action vocabulary and raw/signature contingency. No unseen mapping is invented.
Representation accessibility, effective row count, sparse optimizer accumulators and category-specific random initialization can change one-pass optimization without changing information content.

Aggregate AUC equality does not prove examplewise equality, category bijection, gradient equivalence or statistical equivalence. Host training-only contingency and initial-state checks are required; paired prediction checks are desirable if supported.

Earlier all-valid permutation0.6624208034892454, coarse auxiliary-union permutation0.6631724257525596 and eval-only permutation0.6558015771863462 can reflect disrupted action/mask compatibility or distribution shift. Signature-stratified permutation equaled the original0.6689610675617089 and may have been an identity intervention. These trajectories are retained, not counted as independent corroboration of extra raw-action utility.

Offline whole-window filtering/static snapshots and possibly immature feedback are inherited limitations; no production point-in-time claim. Auxiliary labels are user/category/brand24h outcomes rather than advertisement-specific conversions.

The coding workspace exposes source modules and committed validation receipts, not raw parquet shards, a live GPU, or a training command. Dataset digest re-verification, full forward/backward reproduction and actual action-vocabulary audit cannot be repeated here. Baseline/incumbent source hashes were verified locally; empirical starting quality and cost are inherited observations, and new execution remains exclusively with the authorized host.
